source_text: Accelerate et adducite patrem. Conservavit Deus vitam. Haec Homiliae XVI et totius in Genesim seriei clausula. Amen.
pass_a_gloss: Hasten and bring father. Preserved God life. These of-Homily XVI and of-whole into Genesis series closing. Amen.
pass_b_english: [[Hurry and bring my father >> Bible:Genesis 45:9]]. [[God preserved life >> Bible:Genesis 45:5]]. This is Homily XVI’s close and the close of the whole Genesis series. Amen.
